as_of_content:
The '''Kickback Relics''' are rewarded for mastering the [[Weapon of Mass Consumption]] Spotlight Missions.
==Description==
''A trophy to reward your skills of cunning and deception. This is awarded to those who master the Kickback Special Mission.''
==Relic Boosts==
*(Tier 1): +1% to [[Raid Chip]] rewards
*Bronze: +2%
*Silver: +3%
*Gold: +5%
